description: The shortest way to buy: say the need as your user said it (sizes, budget, place included) and get one decision: the pick with price, stock, store and checkout link, the reasons as data, the same item at other sellers, the cheapest and the best rated, and the next steps as ready requests (read the page, verify the checkout link, check your spending rules, pay, leave a trace). Deterministic rule stated in the answer. Compact: a few hundred tokens.

by.description: Your resident id (mare:...) from enter. Optional.

need.description: The need in plain words, as your user said it. Example: "trail running shoes size 44 under 150 EUR, ships to Germany".

verified.description: true: only offers from stores in the verified market of the Unibrain (their own UCP profile on their own domain, on the web for half a year or more, no text on the home page that tries to command an agent, no strikes). For agents that buy without a person watching. Stores not checked yet are held back and checked within minutes.
